data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 11.2m (2022: favourable development of GBP 3.9m); this is mainly comprised of releases of GBP 7.0m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business, accepted reinsurance of GBP 3.6m and releases of GBP 0.9m in respect of Aviation business, partially offset by strengthening of GBP 0.3m in Other direct.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Management identified uncertainty from opioids and other pharma losses and included a management adjustment in excess of the best estimate of net reserves.

named_events.event_name: Israel Gaza War and the wider Middle East region
named_events.loss_description: Concerns that the conflict could escalate and impact markets; main impact has been requests for policy extensions and lighter touch renewals rather than direct insured losses.

named_events.event_name: Events in Ukraine (Russia's invasion of Ukraine)
named_events.loss_description: Increased geopolitical tensions and sanctions have increased volatility; Syndicate has minimal direct premium from Ukraine and has avoided business from Russia; may face some indirect exposure in Financial Lines and Cyber.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a net release on prior years. On a gross basis the claims development triangle indicates an aggregate favourable movement of approximately GBP 39.5m across underwriting years up to 2021, driven mainly by releases in Third Party Liability, Aviation and reinsurance accepted business. After deducting reinsurers' share the reported net favourable development was GBP 11.2m. This release reduced the overall gross claims outstanding from the opening position and contributed positively to the year result.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 11.2m (2022: favourable development of GBP 3.9m); this is mainly comprised of releases of GBP 7.0m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business, accepted reinsurance of GBP 3.6m and releases of GBP 0.9m in respect of Aviation business, partially offset by strengthening of GBP 0.3m in Other direct.

data.data_quality_notes: The reported net prior year release of GBP 11.2m (net of reinsurance) is stated verbatim in the notes. A gross prior year movement was not explicitly stated as a single aggregate in the movement note (which gave net figures), so the gross prior year movement (-GBP 39.494m) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross of reinsurance). Triangle values are presented in GBP '000 in the report and were converted to millions for this output. No RITC distortion was identified in the technical reserves note. Some breakout amounts quoted in the narrative are net-contextual and mapping between gross and net components may introduce minor allocation uncertainty.
